title: Amigurumi Whale
description: A friendly stuffed whale that builds on the basic ball with simple shaping and finishing.
expectationText: A beginner toy project where round counting and clean decreases matter, but the shaping still stays approachable.

steps.title: Begin the body
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring and place a marker in the first stitch of each round.

steps.title: Increase the body
steps.instruction: Increase evenly over the first rounds until the body forms a shallow cup.

steps.title: Work even rounds
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without increasing to build the main body length.

steps.title: Add eyes and stuffing
steps.instruction: Insert the eyes before the opening gets too tight, then begin stuffing lightly.

steps.title: Shape the tail end
steps.instruction: Use invisible decreases to taper the body while keeping the stitches smooth.

steps.title: Finish the fins and tail
steps.instruction: Sew or crochet simple side fins and a tail shape, then close the final opening and hide the end.
